mandatory.text: Master's or PhD enrolment throughout the internship; undergraduates must be RISE Germany alumni.
Eligible overseas home university; language requirements depend on the placement.

exceptions.text: Recent graduates and placements exceeding three months instead receive host-paid minimum wages without the DAAD monthly stipend.

funding.description: Monthly scholarship: EUR 992 for eligible undergraduates/Master's students or EUR 1,300 for PhD students, including a EUR 500 host contribution; insurance and travel support.
